title: 规避计算套利的计算难度
summary: 本文将AI模型市场中的计算套利形式化为分配问题并证明其一般NP难，但在模型性能随推理支出呈自然递减回报的条件下可高效求得最优分配，并提出样本高效的方法从有限数据估计模型性能，还给出若干经济学洞见。
summary_en: This paper formalizes computational arbitrage in AI model marketplaces as an allocation problem and proves it is generally NP-hard, yet shows the optimal allocation is efficiently computable under a natural diminishing-returns condition on model performance versus inference spending. It also develops a sample-efficient method to estimate model performance from limited data and derives economic insights.
